nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping (address => uint256) holding token balances; mutated in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 private nested mapping (address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding spending allowances; mutated in _approve.
ERC20 private uint256 total token supply; increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
ERC20 private string token name, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
ERC20 private string token symbol, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
GeneratorCopyright private constant string pointing to the token generator URL.
GeneratorCopyright private string generator version, set in the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Context._msgSender() internal view returns msg.sender; used by ERC20 entry points and by the HelloERC20 constructor for the initial mint.
Context._msgData() internal view returns msg.data.
ERC20.name() public view returns state variable _name.
ERC20.symbol() public view returns state variable _symbol.
ERC20.decimals() public view returns constant 18.
ERC20.totalSupply() public view returns state variable _totalSupply.
ERC20.balanceOf(address) public view returns _balances[account].
ERC20.transfer(address,uint256) public entry point; forwards to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
ERC20.allowance(address,address) public view returns _allowances[owner][spender].
ERC20.approve(address,uint256) public entry point; forwards to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public; performs _transfer then checks and decrements the caller allowance via _approve.
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address,uint256) public; writes _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue through _approve.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address,uint256) public; requires currentAllowance >= subtractedValue and re-approves the difference.
ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint256) internal; checks non-zero addresses and balance, updates _balances and emits Transfer.
ERC20._mint(address,uint256) internal; increases _totalSupply and _balances[account] and emits Transfer from zero address.
ERC20._burn(address,uint256) internal; decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply and emits Transfer to zero address.
ERC20._approve(address,address,uint256) internal; checks non-zero addresses, writes _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
ERC20._beforeTokenTransfer(address,address,uint256) internal virtual hook called by _transfer, _mint and _burn (empty body).
IPayable.pay(string) external payable interface function; implemented by the receiver passed to ServicePayer.

ServicePayer constructor (address payable receiver, string serviceName) payable; performs an external payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) with an attacker-supplied receiver address.
GeneratorCopyright constructor (string version_) sets the _version state variable.
GeneratorCopyright.generator() public pure returns the _GENERATOR constant.
GeneratorCopyright.version() public view returns the _version state variable.
HelloERC20 constructor (name_, symbol_, feeReceiver_) payable; inherits ERC20, ServicePayer and GeneratorCopyright and mints 10000e18 tokens to _msgSender().
msg.sender, the caller-controlled origin of transfers, approvals and of the initial mint performed in the HelloERC20 constructor.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed in the ServicePayer constructor with a caller-supplied receiver contract.
Arithmetic write _balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer.
Arithmetic write _totalSupply += amount inside _mint.
Arithmetic computation currentAllowance - amount inside transferFrom (guarded by require).
Arithmetic computation _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue inside increaseAllowance (unchecked addition input).
Arithmetic computation currentAllowance - subtractedValue inside decreaseAllowance (guarded by require).
Arithmetic write _totalSupply -= amount inside _burn.
Arithmetic write _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer (guarded by require).
Arithmetic write _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount inside _burn (guarded by require).
Arithmetic write _balances[account] += amount inside _mint.
Constructor parameter name_ of HelloERC20 forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
Constructor parameter symbol_ of HelloERC20 forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
Constructor parameter feeReceiver_ of HelloERC20 forwarded to the ServicePayer constructor as the payable receiver.

Local variable currentAllowance of decreaseAllowance.
Parameter sender of internal _transfer.
Parameter recipient of internal _transfer.
Parameter amount of internal _transfer used in the balance subtraction and addition.
Local variable senderBalance of _transfer read from _balances and used in the subtraction.
Parameter account of _mint, receiving the newly created tokens.
Parameter amount of _mint added to supply and balance.
Parameter account of _burn.
Parameter amount of _burn subtracted from balance and supply.
Local variable accountBalance of _burn used in the subtraction.

Parameter spender of internal _approve.

Constructor parameter version_ of GeneratorCopyright stored into _version.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by Context._msgSender(), the only untrusted input source feeding authorization logic.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token movement, so caller identity controls the transferred balance.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner, so caller identity controls the allowance written.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() to look up and decrement the caller allowance.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as owner when writing the allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as owner when reading and writing the allowance.
HelloERC20 constructor mints 10000e18 tokens to _msgSender(), i.e. to the deploying caller.
_transfer writes the sender and recipient entries of the _balances mapping.
_mint increases _balances[account] by the minted amount.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_burn decreases _balances[account] by the burned amount.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_approve is the only writer of the _allowances mapping entries.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] to validate the spend.
increaseAllowance reads the current allowance and writes the sum back into _allowances.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance and writes the difference back into _allowances.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
name reads the _name state variable.
symbol reads the _symbol state variable.
version reads the _version state variable.
generator returns the _GENERATOR constant.
GeneratorCopyright constructor writes the _version state variable.
_transfer performs the unchecked-in-0.8-style balance addition _balances[recipient] += amount.
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount.
transferFrom performs currentAllowance - amount after the require check.
increaseAllowance performs _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue.
decreaseAllowance performs currentAllowance - subtractedValue.
_burn performs _totalSupply -= amount.
_transfer performs _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount.
_burn performs _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount.
_mint performs _balances[account] += amount.
name_ parameter is forwarded by the HelloERC20 constructor to the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter is forwarded by the HelloERC20 constructor to the ERC20 constructor.
feeReceiver_ parameter is forwarded by the HelloERC20 constructor to the ServicePayer constructor.
account parameter indexes the _balances mapping in balanceOf.
recipient parameter is passed to _transfer from transfer.
amount parameter is passed to _transfer from transfer.
spender parameter is passed to _approve from approve.
amount parameter is passed to _approve from approve.
sender parameter is passed to _transfer inside transferFrom.
recipient parameter is passed to _transfer inside transferFrom.
amount parameter is used for the transfer and the allowance check in transferFrom.
spender parameter is used as the allowance key in increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance in increaseAllowance.
spender parameter is used as the allowance key in decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is compared and subtracted in decreaseAllowance.
sender parameter is the debited account in internal _transfer.
recipient parameter is the credited account in internal _transfer.
amount parameter is subtracted and added in internal _transfer.
account parameter receives the minted balance in _mint.
amount parameter increases supply and balance in _mint.
account parameter is debited in _burn.
amount parameter decreases balance and supply in _burn.
owner parameter is the allowance key owner in _approve.
spender parameter is the allowance key spender in _approve.
amount parameter is written into _allowances in _approve.
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in allowance.
receiver parameter becomes the target contract of the external pay call in the ServicePayer constructor.
serviceName parameter is forwarded to the external pay call in the ServicePayer constructor.
version_ parameter is stored into _version by the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
transfer amount reaches the _balances[recipient] += amount arithmetic.
addedValue reaches the allowance addition arithmetic in increaseAllowance.
internal transfer amount reaches the senderBalance - amount arithmetic.
mint amount reaches the _balances[account] += amount arithmetic.
burn amount reaches the _totalSupply -= amount arithmetic.
transferFrom amount reaches the currentAllowance - amount arithmetic.
local currentAllowance reaches the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
local currentAllowance reaches the allowance subtraction in decreaseAllowance.
local senderBalance reaches the balance subtraction in _transfer.
local accountBalance reaches the balance subtraction in _burn.
transfer delegates token movement to internal _transfer.
transfer calls _msgSender() to determine the source account.
approve delegates allowance writing to internal _approve.
approve calls _msgSender() to determine the allowance owner.
transferFrom performs the underlying transfer before allowance accounting.
transferFrom re-approves the reduced allowance through _approve.
transferFrom calls _msgSender() to identify the spender.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance calls _msgSender() to identify the owner of the allowance.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance calls _msgSender() to identify the owner of the allowance.
_transfer triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_mint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating supply and balances.
_burn triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances and supply.
HelloERC20 constructor calls _mint to create the initial 10000e18 supply.
HelloERC20 constructor calls _msgSender() as the mint beneficiary at deployment time.
ServicePayer constructor invokes the external IPayable.pay function on the caller-supplied receiver contract, transferring control to untrusted code.
ServicePayer constructor executes the low-level external payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) before initialization completes.
